sections.description_of_main_ingredients:
Triphala – It comprises Amalaki ( Emblica officinalis ), Bibhitaki ( Terminalia bellerica), Haritaki ( Terminalia chebula ). It pacifies all the three dosha and is very effective in promoting digestive fire. It acts as laxative and improves the peristaltic movements of the intestine. This helps in relieving pain, inflammation and encourages weight loss. 
 Pippali Churna – Pippali ( Piper longum) mainly pacifies vata and kapha dosha and increases the appetite by promoting the secretion of gastric juices. It is also useful in Rheumatoid arthritis, fever, pain etc. 
 Chitrakmool – This is called Plumbago zeylanica. Due to the pungent effect, it acts as an appetizer and digestant. It is useful in indigestion, anorexia, abdominal pain. 
 Shunthi – Shunthi is known as Zingiber officinale. This is very effective in digestive problems. It pacifies Vata and kapha dosha. It is helpful in bloating, diarrhea. 
 Vaividang ( Embelia ribes) – This herb is very good at deworming the body. It has hot potency and mainly pacifies vata and kapha dosha. It is mentioned under krimighna (deworming agent), kushtha ghana (helpful in treating skin ailments). It has antimicrobial, anti bacterial and rejuvenating properties. 

 Method of Preparation 

 Properly mix all the above ingredients in a kharal yantra. 
 Give bhavna with water for 3 hours and again mix this mixture. 
 Make 250 mg tablets and dry them under shadow. 
 Kept these tablets in a glass container. 

 Medicinal Properties 
 Kanadi loha is an Ayurvedic formulation. It is effective in diarrhea by improving digestive power. The ingredients in this formulation have digestive and appetizer action. They stimulate digestive fire.

Kanadi Loha 
 Reference – Bhaishajya-Ratnavali Atisaradhikar 252/164-165 
 Introduction 
 Kanadi loha is a Herbo-mineral composition. The ingredients in this formulation are useful in improving digestive health. They stimulate digestive fire and improve digestion. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Amalaki Churna – 100 gms 
 Bibhitaki Churna – 100 gms 
 Haritaki Churna – 100 gms 
 Pippali Churna – 100 gms 
 Shunthi – 100 gms 
 Chitrakmool – 100 gms 
 Patha Churna ( Cissampelos pareira ) – 100 gms 
 Vaividang ( Embelia ribes ) – 100 gms 
 Nagarmotha Churna ( Cyperus scariosus ) – 100 gms 
 Bilva Churna ( Aegle marmelos ) – 100 gms 
 Shwet Chandan (white Sandalwood) – 100 gms 
 Netrabalachurna ( Berberis aristata ) – 100 gms 
 Loha Bhasma (Iron ash) – 1.200 gms 
 
 Description of Main Ingredients 
 
 Triphala – It comprises Amalaki ( Emblica officinalis ), Bibhitaki ( Terminalia bellerica), Haritaki ( Terminalia chebula ). It pacifies all the three dosha and is very effective in promoting digestive fire. It acts as laxative and improves the peristaltic movements of the intestine. This helps in relieving pain, inflammation and encourages weight loss. 
 Pippali Churna – Pippali ( Piper longum) mainly pacifies vata and kapha dosha and increases the appetite by promoting the secretion of gastric juices. It is also useful in Rheumatoid arthritis, fever, pain etc. 
 Chitrakmool – This is called Plumbago zeylanica. Due to the pungent effect, it acts as an appetizer and digestant. It is useful in indigestion, anorexia, abdominal pain. 
 Shunthi – Shunthi is known as Zingiber officinale. This is very effective in digestive problems. It pacifies Vata and kapha dosha. It is helpful in bloating, diarrhea. 
 Vaividang ( Embelia ribes) – This herb is very good at deworming the body. It has hot potency and mainly pacifies vata and kapha dosha. It is mentioned under krimighna (deworming agent), kushtha ghana (helpful in treating skin ailments). It has antimicrobial, anti bacterial and rejuvenating properties. 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Properly mix all the above ingredients in a kharal yantra. 
 Give bhavna with water for 3 hours and again mix this mixture. 
 Make 250 mg tablets and dry them under shadow. 
 Kept these tablets in a glass container. 
 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Kanadi loha is an Ayurvedic formulation. It is effective in diarrhea by improving digestive power. The ingredients in this formulation have digestive and appetizer action. They stimulate digestive fire. 
 Indications 
 
 Diarrhea 
 Dysentery 
 Grahani 
 
 Dosage 
 2 tablets twice a day with lukewarm water. 
 Cautions 
 Take under medical supervision. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
